facts.fact: CITADEL (Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo) says its national data portal for public decision-making has 147 datasets available and 12 in validation, with no public API, as of 17 June 2026; no licence is stated.

facts.fact: CITADEL says its portal holds more than 145 datasets from more than 5 national agencies and official portals.
